scope: Read-only installed CLI version/help checks and selected package source inspection; no model prompts, callback messages, authentication checks or configuration changes.

harnesses.name: Grok Build
harnesses.candidateRoute: Host-managed background task or one silent monitor; docs reviewed, Fungi integration untested

harnesses.name: Pi

limits: Command installation does not establish authentication or model access.
No live agent return or AFK-duration test has been performed for Fungi.
A pending call resumes on tool completion; it is distinct from waking an already-ended turn.
Documentation may describe a newer revision than installed software; verify behavior during implementation.
